description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator classes for null, carriage return, and line feed, as well as a template class for stream text handling with support for different terminators and data sources. It appears to be part of a core library for text stream management within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for handling text streams with customizable source and terminator, supporting data sending, receiving, and state management.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if a character is a terminator based on the specific terminator class.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the stream, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the stream, processing terminator sequences.
